# `mcp-scaffold apply`

- **Usage**: `mcp-scaffold apply [FLAGS]`

Apply migrations to an existing repo

## Flags

### `--target <dir>`

Path to the existing repo

### `--execute`

Actually apply (default is dry-run)

### `--force`

Overwrite files that diverge from the template (default: preserve user customizations)

### `--name <name>`

Tool name (kebab-case)

### `--scope <scope>`

Npm scope, with leading @

### `--no-tui`

Skip the Ink/React TUI surface

### `--no-http`

Skip the Streamable HTTP transport

### `--no-rust-accel`

Skip the optional Rust acceleration crate

### `--no-semantic-release`

Skip the semantic-release workflow
